title: Track your order
body: You can track any order from My Orders. Open the order and use the tracking link, or enter the order id (for example SE-100234). Tracking updates within a few hours of dispatch.

title: Where is my order
body: If an order has not arrived by the estimated date, check the tracking link first. Most delays clear within two days. If tracking has not updated in 48 hours, contact support.

title: How returns work
body: Items can be returned within 10 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Start a return from My Orders; a prepaid label is emailed to you.

title: Refund timelines
body: Once we receive a returned item, refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Warranty overview
body: Most products carry a manufacturer warranty. The warranty period and what it covers depend on the product and brand. Warranty claims are reviewed by a support agent.

title: Register your warranty
body: You can register a product for warranty from My Orders within 30 days of delivery. Registration does not decide a claim; claims are assessed case by case.

title: Return exceptions
body: Some categories cannot be returned once opened, including earphones and personal care items, for hygiene reasons. Damaged-on-arrival items are always accepted.

title: Order id format
body: Order ids start with SE- followed by six digits. If a customer gives a different format, ask them to check the confirmation email.

title: Warranty disputes (sensitive)
body: A warranty dispute (a rejected claim, or a disagreement about coverage) is legally sensitive. It must be handled by a human agent, never decided automatically. Route it to the warranty desk with the order id and the customer's description.

title: Cancel an order
body: An order can be cancelled before it is dispatched from My Orders. After dispatch, it must be returned instead.

title: Exchange for a different size
body: Exchanges are handled as a return plus a new order. Start a return, then place a fresh order for the size you want.

title: Contact a human agent
body: For anything outside order status, returns, and simple warranty questions, or when the customer is unhappy, hand the conversation to a human agent with the full context.
